ALL LIVE. FTSE closed 16:35 at 10,441.60 -0.16. Wall Street open, so .SPX and .VIX are live intraday.

*** THE DAY'S STORY IS A ROUND TRIP, NOT A LEVEL ***
Gilts spiked and reversed. The Guardian reported at midday that the UK 10-year hit 5.515%, the highest
since July 2007, and the 30-year 6.0117% after touching 6.036% on Wednesday, the highest since January
1998. By the 18:15 close CNBC reads the 10-year at 5.4248 and Trading Economics at 5.43 (-0.006 on the
day); TE has the 30-year back at 5.94 (-0.041). The reversal tracks Donald Trump's Truth Social post
ruling out a strike on Iran before the 3 November midterms, which also pulled Brent back from an intraday
$105.30 to about $103. The drivers carry the intraday highs AND the close, because publishing only the
close would hide the actual event.

GILT BASIS: CNBC's previous_day_closing read 5.4852 — that is THIS MORNING's level, not Wednesday's close,
so the field is unusable again. Computed against Wednesday's established close of 5.4362:
  5.4248 - 5.4362 = -0.0114 -> -0.01
Trading Economics independently gives -0.006, which also rounds to -0.01. Agreement on direction and size.

UST: 5.246 against Wednesday's close of 5.277 = -0.031 -> -0.03. US30Y 5.621 (prev 5.661).
